post.originalText:
FREE DEEPSEEK V4.1 FLASH THOUGHT FOR 32,000 TOKENS AND WROTE ZERO LINES. TWICE. THEN I FOUND THE SWITCH

the prompt: a 3D mechanical watch movement in one HTML file. a gear train that meshes, an escapement, a balance wheel at 4 Hz, real time on the hands and a button for an exploded view

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is free in OpenCode right now. on default settings it spent its whole 32K budget thinking, both runs, about 4 minutes each, and never wrote a file

on the third run i set thinking to low. 7 minutes, 885 lines, and it fixed its own screw positions halfway through. the exploded view works and every layer stays in frame

Opus 5.5 got the same prompt for about 16 cents of output. 461 lines, striped gold bridges, blued screws, a mainspring you can see. but its camera sits too close and the exploded layers fly out of the shot

on a build like this the free model is close. the catch is one setting. on big one-file builds put DeepSeek on low thinking, or it burns the whole budget before line one

0 lines, 0 lines, 885 lines. the $0 model just needed to be told to think less

sourceMaterials.text: @semichenkko it built the nicer watch for sure. deepseek still won the camera though, and it cost $0
